A NOTATION THIS BRIEF DOES NOT LIST: on BOTH schedule pages the filer drew ONE LONG DIAGONAL STROKE from the bottom-left of the ruled grid to its top-right to void the unused remainder of the sheet. It is not a struck ROW (§C4) — it crosses many lines at once, carries no figure, and consumes no printed line — and it does not shift any row index; on p3 the single written entry still sits on band 1, proven by crop. Treating such a stroke as a voided row would be an error, and it is recorded here as precedent. FOLIATION counts the cover on this filing: summary 'Page 2 of 4', Schedule A '3 of 4', Schedule B '4 of 4' — a different practice from the Ratcliffe filing in this same chunk and cycle ('1 of 3' excluding the cover) and from the Smith filing ('1 of 1'), which is three conventions inside one chunk of one year. Column B cumulative figures (contributions 16,395.00, expenditures 16,854.71) are retained as cumulative and never summed as increments; note they are UNEQUAL, so this is not a wound-up-account report.
